summary: Merge sort splits an array in half, sorts each half recursively, and merges the two sorted halves. It runs in O(n log n) time on every input.
notes: mergeSort takes lo and hi indexes instead of copying the array. The range is [lo, hi), so hi is not included.
One temp array is created in sort() and reused by every merge call.
System.arraycopy(temp, lo, scores, lo, hi - lo) copies the merged range back into scores.
pitfall: Using the base case hi - lo == 0 instead of hi - lo <= 1 makes a one-item range split into itself forever and ends with StackOverflowError.
